newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST - Next set for strong first half.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Next set for strong first half.

text.p: Clothing and home shopping group Next Plc is set to display another set of solid half year results next Wednesday, aided by more upbeat consumer spending, analysts said.

The group, which has consistently outperformed many of its retailing rivals, is expected to make half year pre-tax profits of 53 million to 55 million stg, up from 44.1 million a year ago. Analysts forecasts averaged 54.42 million.
The dividend is seen rising about 23 percent to 4.60 pence from last year's 3.75 pence, with forecasts in a range between 4.35 and 4.70 pence.
Analysts said they believed Next's sales momentum has been going well in the half year and probably kept pace with the 16 percent rise seen at Next retail in the first 15 weeks of its summer season.
They believe Next Directory, the mail order business, has also seen strong sales growth to match the 19 percent is achieved in the first weeks of the summer.
"It's a story of continued success," said one analyst.
